defect: S0's effective_config() greps the last 9MB of /var/log/qwen27-mtp.log; that tail is contaminated by vLLM-logged PROMPT TEXT from the foundry arm's V9 needle haystack, which was built from real text containing verbatim copies of old log lines. The parser therefore read an init line from a logged prompt (Aug 4 15:22/20:36 boots: max_seq_len=262144, kv 1,436,030) instead of the current boot's real init line.

impact_on_window: None on measurements: all S1 legs ran against the live 1M baseline (confirmed from the server, not the log). S2/S5 invariant checks parse correctly because immediately after a restart the fresh boot's init line is the newest content in the tail and my matrix documents are word-salad that cannot mimic log lines.
lesson: Log-grep readback is unforgeable only when the server does not log request payloads; on this box vLLM logs prompts, so any prompt can inject log-shaped text. Prefer /v1/models and /proc/<pid>/cmdline for config readback; use log-grep only anchored immediately after a restart.
